reasoning: On the season so far the Lakers are the stronger team; with home court the Lakers start about 15 points better, in a game of about 232 points.
Rest, travel and who is missing tilt it about 1 point towards the Lakers.
There are psychological storylines, but history says they are worth little here.
Bottom line: the Lakers win 86 times in 100, by about 16; most games like this end between 206 and 255 total points.

analyst.text: Milwaukee are 1-10, have lost seven straight, and are one loss from tying the worst start in franchise history. Taylor Jenkins admits "what we're doing right now is not working", and Kyle Kuzma, facing the team where he started his career, has called for more urgency. Tyler Herro (knee) is out again, and the Bucks are on a back-to-back after a 32-point loss to the Knicks. The Lakers are on a six-game winning streak behind Luka Doncic. Everything mental leans toward Los Angeles.
